Was this bot intended to post here? It seems like it'd be better suited to its own thread in the LeanEval channel.
Oh yeah good point. Happy to move it.
I don't have permission to delete/move the message, so someone please do so for me.
Oh I realize LeanEval doesn't have its own channel. Which one would be most appropriate to move to? Maybe #Autoformalization?
Yeah I'm happy with that.
6 messages were moved here from #general > Discussion thread for AnnalsChallange by Chris Henson.
(deleted)

Ah, I tried to set up a second bot as a proper bot vs a webhook so maybe I could delete/move the messages myself in the future, and it just reposted :sweat_smile:. Sorry this is my first time setting something up like this. This shouldn't happen again.
No worries. I am curious, what will be the usual trigger for the bot to post?

It’s a GitHub action that triggers every 5 minutes and looks to see if there are new accepted submissions, which are filed as issues under “annals”.

That being said, this was vibe-coded with Claude so I’m kinda hoping for the best :fingers_crossed:.

Edit: here’s the link in case people are curious https://github.com/homeowmorphism/annals-tracker

Please no bots posting on Zulip without first some discussion of what they will do / where they will post.

I'm skeptical that we want bots posting to the Zulip about first solves of lean-eval problems. Note that the planned #Model comparisons for Lean > LeanEval overhaul will include a page for recently solves, which hopefully solves the same problem less noisily.

But if others disagree, I'm happy to discuss.

Kim Morrison said:

But if others disagree, I'm happy to discuss.

I actually would like a bot that posts first-solves for Lean-Eval/AnnalsChallenge. We already have many bot threads that one can mute if they like, and I will basically never visit the lean-eval recent solves page and would like to passively track updates on Zulip (similar to how I am appreciate being able to quickly scroll mathlib4 commits in #rss and otherwise would probably not do so on my own.)

@Kim Morrison

Please no bots posting on Zulip without first some discussion of what they will do / where they will post.

Ah my bad, I got excited the bot was working and went ahead, but I see the point of discussing it first. I've deactivated the bot posting for now, and will ask next time.

But if others disagree, I'm happy to discuss.

My motivation was similar to Vlad’s point: I wanted an easy way to passively keep up with the progress of these benchmarks, and I was especially excited to follow this one. I thought a tracker might be a fun/useful way to do that.
I wonder how many of these are genuine proofs and how many are "oops the statement as formalised turned out to be trivial for the wrong reasons"
Like Hodge's general conjecture?
@Kevin Buzzard , I can privately send you the 27 solutions I have, if you would like to inspect them.
Oh I would love that Vasily! Would you be ok if I passed them on to my team too? Many thanks in advance!
